lessons.trigger_condition: V420 computes a fresh verified evidence activation score during registry review and can promote WATCH games, but the raw tablet registry/UI only retained seed activation_score and catalog depth. Operators could not see the current evidence score between review reports, and directly overwriting activation_score would create stale-score self-reinforcement risk.
lessons.prevention_rule: Persist the freshly recomputed evidence score only as evidence.verified_activation_score plus a bounded verified_activation_gate diagnostic object. Never consume that persisted observability field as an activation input; promotion continues to recompute from fresh official/market signals and uses seed_activation_score only as the pre-existing bounded seed. Show the verified score read-only on WATCH tablet UI and keep WATCH purchase/grading disabled.
validation_required: tcg_game_registry persists verified_activation_score and verified_activation_gate only for non-core rows
persisted verified_activation_score is never read by _evidence_activation_score or activation=max(seed,evidence)
a stale preloaded verified_activation_score of 0.99 cannot promote a candidate when fresh evidence gates fail
tablet WATCH summary shows verified activation score read-only
WATCH games remain non-selectable for purchase and grading until promotion
Pokémon ONE PIECE NARUTO remain the only grading-enabled game IDs
mandatory collection job count remains exactly 8
screen neural remains exactly 17 inputs 12 hidden units and 18 allowlisted outputs
profit guarantee investment-return prediction and market-direction prediction remain false
no runtime source auto-rewrite arbitrary command direct-main write or verification bypass is introduced
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until matching device-side receipt exists
lessons.safety_boundary: This lesson adds observability for freshly recomputed verified evidence only. It does not make stored scores authoritative, predict profit or price direction, fabricate stock, auto-enable non-core grading, alter the 17→12→18 neural architecture, bypass CI, or claim physical Lenovo deployment.
